import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 44
HEAD = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.fps = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.film = nn.Linear(W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, self.n_types * HEAD, 1)
        heads = []
        for _ in range(self.n_types):
            out = nn.Conv2d(HEAD, 1, 1)
            nn.init.orthogonal_(out.weight, gain=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(out.bias)
            heads.append(nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2 * HEAD, HEAD, 1), nn.ReLU(), out))
        self.type_heads = nn.ModuleList(heads)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, gain=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        h = F.relu(self.stem(obs))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv1(h))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv2(h))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        h2 = F.relu(h + self.film(g)[:, :, None, None])
        p = self.proj(h2)
        outs = []
        for t in range(self.n_types):
            dy, dx = self.fps[t]
            pt = p[:, t * HEAD:(t + 1) * HEAD]
            pp = F.pad(pt, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            av = F.avg_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            outs.append(self.type_heads[t](torch.cat([mx, av], dim=1)).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(outs, dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

For each brick type it projects per-layer features, pools them over the footprint, and scores each candidate layer z with one small network shared across layers plus a learned layer embedding. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 40
K = 6
HID = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.fps = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, W), nn.ReLU())
        self.film = nn.Linear(W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, self.n_types * self.Z * K, 1)
        self.hid = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2 * K, HID) for _ in range(self.n_types)])
        self.zemb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.n_types, self.Z, HID))
        outs = []
        for _ in range(self.n_types):
            o = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, gain=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
            outs.append(o)
        self.out = nn.ModuleList(outs)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, gain=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        h = F.relu(self.stem(obs))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv1(h))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv2(h))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        h2 = F.relu(h + self.film(g)[:, :, None, None])
        p = self.proj(h2)
        outs = []
        for t in range(self.n_types):
            dy, dx = self.fps[t]
            pt = p[:, t * Z * K:(t + 1) * Z * K]
            pp = F.pad(pt, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1).reshape(B, Z, K, Y, X)
            av = F.avg_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1).reshape(B, Z, K, Y, X)
            q = torch.cat([mx, av], dim=2).permute(0, 3, 4, 1, 2)
            z = F.relu(self.hid[t](q) + self.zemb[t])
            s = self.out[t](z).squeeze(-1)
            outs.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=-1).reshape(B, Y * X))
        place = torch.cat(outs, dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

WIDTH = 16
K = 8
HID = 16
GW = 64
CIN = 12


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.fps = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(CIN, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(3 * W, W, 1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(self.Z * W + W, GW), nn.ReLU())
        self.film = nn.Linear(GW, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, self.n_types * K, 1)
        heads = []
        for _ in range(self.n_types):
            out = nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1)
            nn.init.orthogonal_(out.weight, gain=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(out.bias)
            heads.append(nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2 * K, HID, 1), nn.ReLU(), out))
        self.type_heads = nn.ModuleList(heads)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GW, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, gain=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GW, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        W = WIDTH
        bld = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        mis = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        ext = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        bb = F.pad(bld, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)[:, :Z]
        tb = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)[:, :Z]
        ba = F.pad(bld, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        ta = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        hb = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1].expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        ht = obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2].expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        tm = obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3].expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.stack([bld, tgt, mis, ext, bb, tb, ba, ta, hb, ht, tm, zc], dim=2)
        x = x.reshape(B * Z, CIN, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.stem(x))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv1(h))
        hz = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        below = torch.cummax(hz, dim=1).values
        above = torch.flip(torch.cummax(torch.flip(hz, [1]), dim=1).values, [1])
        m = torch.cat([hz, below, above], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 3 * W, Y, X)
        h = h + F.relu(self.mix(m))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv2(h))
        hz = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        pooled = torch.cat([hz.mean((3, 4)).reshape(B, Z * W), hz.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        h2 = F.relu(hz + self.film(g)[:, None, :, None, None]).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        p = self.proj(h2)
        outs = []
        for t in range(self.n_types):
            dy, dx = self.fps[t]
            pt = p[:, t * K:(t + 1) * K]
            pp = F.pad(pt, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            av = F.avg_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = self.type_heads[t](torch.cat([mx, av], dim=1)).reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            outs.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(outs, dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.fps = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.Z = spec.Z
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(CIN, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(3 * W, W, 1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(self.Z * W + W, GW), nn.ReLU())
        self.film = nn.Linear(GW, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, self.n_types * K, 1)
        heads = []
        for _ in range(self.n_types):
            out = nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1)
            nn.init.orthogonal_(out.weight, gain=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(out.bias)
            heads.append(nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2 * K, HID, 1), nn.ReLU(), out))
        self.type_heads = nn.ModuleList(heads)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GW, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, gain=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GW, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        W = WIDTH
        bld = obs[:, 0:Z]
        tgt = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        mis = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        ext = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        bb = F.pad(bld, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)[:, :Z]
        tb = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0), value=1.0)[:, :Z]
        ba = F.pad(bld, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        ta = F.pad(tgt, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        hb = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 1].expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        ht = obs[:, 4 * Z + 1:4 * Z + 2].expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        tm = obs[:, 4 * Z + 2:4 * Z + 3].expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.stack([bld, tgt, mis, ext, bb, tb, ba, ta, hb, ht, tm, zc], dim=2)
        x = x.reshape(B * Z, CIN, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.stem(x))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv1(h))
        hz = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        below = torch.cummax(hz, dim=1).values
        above = torch.flip(torch.cummax(torch.flip(hz, [1]), dim=1).values, [1])
        m = torch.cat([hz, below, above], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 3 * W, Y, X)
        h = h + F.relu(self.mix(m))
        h = h + F.relu(self.conv2(h))
        hz = h.reshape(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        pooled = torch.cat([hz.mean((3, 4)).reshape(B, Z * W), hz.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1)
        g = self.glob(pooled)
        h2 = F.relu(hz + self.film(g)[:, None, :, None, None]).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        p = self.proj(h2)
        outs = []
        for t in range(self.n_types):
            dy, dx = self.fps[t]
            pt = p[:, t * K:(t + 1) * K]
            pp = F.pad(pt, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            av = F.avg_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = self.type_heads[t](torch.cat([mx, av], dim=1)).reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            outs.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(outs, dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

WIDTH = 32
DILS = [1, 2, 4, 1]
HEAD = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        W = WIDTH
        self.fps = [(int(fp[0]), int(fp[1])) for fp in spec.footprints]
        self.n_types = spec.n_types
        self.stem = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + 2, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=d, dilation=d) for d in DILS])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 2 * W), nn.ReLU())
        self.film = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, self.n_types * HEAD, 1)
        heads = []
        for _ in range(self.n_types):
            out = nn.Conv2d(HEAD, 1, 1)
            nn.init.orthogonal_(out.weight, gain=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(out.bias)
            heads.append(nn.Sequential(nn.Conv2d(2 * HEAD, HEAD, 1), nn.ReLU(), out))
        self.type_heads = nn.ModuleList(heads)
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(2 * W, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, gain=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(2 * W, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, _, Y, X = obs.shape
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([obs, ys, xs], dim=1)
        h = F.relu(self.stem(x))
        for conv in self.convs:
            h = h + F.relu(conv(h))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        h2 = F.relu(h + self.film(g)[:, :, None, None])
        p = self.proj(h2)
        outs = []
        for t in range(self.n_types):
            dy, dx = self.fps[t]
            pt = p[:, t * HEAD:(t + 1) * HEAD]
            pp = F.pad(pt, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            mx = F.max_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            av = F.avg_pool2d(pp, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            outs.append(self.type_heads[t](torch.cat([mx, av], dim=1)).flatten(1))
        place = torch.cat(outs, dim=1)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1:
There are no results yet, and scores are hidden for the whole search. So each candidate has to be a good bet on its own. The training budget scales as 1/r, so a network more expensive than the starting one gets proportionally fewer samples (default budget is only about 32 updates). A network cheaper than r=1 gains nothing, because r below 1 counts as 1. All three candidates therefore stay at about r≈0.95.

The task needs two things for each placement: the landing layer, which is the maximum build height under the brick's footprint, and whether every footprint cell at that layer is a missing target cell with nothing still missing below it. That is an AND/max logic over the footprint. Pooling learned features over each brick's own footprint (allowed after the first learned layer) gives the placement head direct access to it. Global features added back to every cell can tell each cell about overall progress.

Candidate 1 is the base design. Candidate 2 changes only the training recipe (fewer epochs, more samples). Candidate 3 changes only the head, scoring each possible landing layer separately.
analyses.2: Scores are hidden, so only the check results are evidence. All three round-1 files passed the checks and trained without errors. Each one used about the starting network's compute, so neither depth with footprint pooling nor the per-layer OR head adds training cost. The choices below come from reasoning about the task. Whether a placement is right depends mostly on things near the brick: the landing layer is the highest built cell under the footprint, every footprint cell must be missing at that layer, and empty cells under the brick must stay empty in the target. So the network needs to compare layers accurately more than it needs a wide view. Mixed 2D features in r1c3 may blur that comparison. Round 2 tests three different explanations: a layer-shared 2.5D encoder that lines up layers z-1, z and z+1; a stronger end-of-episode signal for the +1 exact-build bonus; and more capacity paired with more samples. Each is one main change from a round-1 file, so the final reseeding can compare them.
analyses.3: Scores are hidden in this search, so I can only reason from design and budget. All six trials so far trained without errors. That includes the brick-shaped scoring head, the one-layer-at-a-time encoder (r2c2), the larger-sample recipe (2 PPO epochs) and the wider network. None of these comparisons can be read without scores, so the best use of the remaining trials is to cover different strong directions. The final selection compares the top 3 by real dev score over 4 seeds. Here are the three candidates. (1) Push the trade of PPO epochs for samples further: 1 epoch gives about 426,000 environment steps, using 512 parallel worlds to keep wall time down. (2) Give the one-layer-at-a-time encoder the larger-sample recipe plus longer credit assignment (gamma 0.99), since that encoder had only default settings. (3) A deeper, narrower residual network at equal compute: its 11x11 view covers the whole 10x10 grid, so it can reason in more steps about how layers and heights relate.
analyses.4: I can't see any scores, so every candidate in this search so far is still an untested bet. All nine trials trained without errors and stayed close to the starting compute, apart from r2c3 at 1.9x. The ideas I trust most on priors are these: the footprint-pooled placement head (it matches how a brick lands), fewer PPO epochs so the agent sees more fresh designs (there is no fixed dataset to overfit), gamma 0.99 (so the +1 exact-build bonus and the choice of when to stop count more), and a wider view across the grid. The wide network costs samples, and its compute is close to 2x. Since this is the last round, the best use of it is to combine changes that each seem promising on their own. The three trials with the best real dev scores go on to 2 more seeds, so diverse, solid combinations are better than single-change ablations. I propose: the deep narrow trunk plus gamma 0.99; the 1-epoch, 512-env recipe plus gamma 0.99; and a new idea, a dilated deep trunk with coordinate channels.
